tasks.old_behavior: nmcli device show for bond/bridge devices outputs fields NAME and SLAVES only in the BOND/BRIDGE section.
tasks.new_behavior: nmcli device show for bond/bridge devices now outputs an additional PORTS field (index 2) showing the same port list as SLAVES. Existing SLAVES field content unchanged.
tasks.compatibility_reason: The new PORTS field appears in the nmcli device show output for bond/bridge/team devices. Any script that parses nmcli output by column position could be affected if PORTS is selected. However, the developer explicitly preserved the old SLAVES field name and its content, so scripts using the old field name continue to work. The change is intentionally backward-compatible.
tasks.test_recommendation: Run nmcli device show with --fields on a bond/bridge device and verify both SLAVES and PORTS contain identical port lists. Run the existing golden output tests (test-client) which have been updated for the new fields.

tasks.old_behavior: nmcli connection show for active connections outputs GENERAL.MASTER-PATH field showing the controller device D-Bus path.
tasks.new_behavior: nmcli connection show now outputs an additional GENERAL.CONTROLLER-PATH field showing the same controller device D-Bus path as GENERAL.MASTER-PATH.
tasks.compatibility_reason: A new GENERAL.CONTROLLER-PATH field appears in nmcli connection show output. The commit message explicitly states this is a backward-compatible addition: 'Instead of replacing them, we add a new field that will show the same value with the new name.' Existing GENERAL.MASTER-PATH is preserved.
tasks.test_recommendation: Run 'nmcli connection show' and verify both CONTROLLER-PATH and MASTER-PATH fields exist and contain identical values. Run existing test-client golden output tests.
